APIErrorResponse.description:
APIErrorResponse is the top-level envelope wrapping a ResponseError.
All API error responses use this shape: { "error": { ... } }.

error.description: The error object containing details about what went wrong.

APIKey.description: An API key used to authenticate requests to the Augno API.

name.description: Human-readable name for the API key.

redacted_value.description:
Redacted key value safe for display.

The key's prefix followed by its last four characters, e.g. `aug_sk_prod_****hjt4`.

role.description: Role assigned to the key, which determines the permissions of requests made with it.

last_used_at.description:
When the key was last used to authenticate a request.

Updated at most once every 24 hours, so it may lag the key's most recent use. `null` if the key has never been used.

expires_at.description:
When the key expires and stops authenticating.

`null` if the key never expires.

revoked_at.description:
When the key's revocation takes effect.

A future timestamp means revocation was scheduled (for example, during rotation) and the key continues to authenticate requests until that time. `null` if the key has not been revoked.

Account.description: A customer account, including its branding and customer portal sub-resources.

name.description: Display name.

branding.description: Customer-facing branding for the account, such as the logo, support contacts, and social links.

portal.description: The account's customer portal settings, including the portal URL slug.

AccountGroup.description: A named grouping of customer accounts, used for pricing rules or to categorize accounts.

name.description:
Display name of the account group.

Unique within the account.

description.description: Free-form description of the account group.

commission_policy.description:
How sales commission applies to accounts in this group.

- `commission_applied`: sales commission is calculated on orders from accounts in this group.
- `commission_exempt`: orders from accounts in this group are exempt from commission.

freight_policy.description:
How freight charges apply to orders from accounts in this group.

- `free_freight`: customers within this group will not have to pay for freight.
- `billed_freight`: freight will be applied to any order within this account group, unless overridden elsewhere.

type.description:
How this account group is used.

- `pricing_group`: used for pricing rules, such as a "Preferred" group that receives a special discount.
- `type_group`: used to categorize accounts, such as "Consumers" or "Distributors".

slug.description:
URL slug that identifies the account's customer portal.

Unique across all accounts.

AccountStatus.description: AccountStatus is a lookup value describing the standing of a customer account, such as whether shipments or all activity should be held.

code.description:
Machine-readable status code.

This is the value used as a customer's `status`.

- `normal`: standard account with no restrictions.
- `preferred`: account flagged as preferred (e.g. for prioritized handling).
- `hold_shipment`: shipments to this account are held; orders may still be placed.
- `hold_all`: all activity for this account is held.

name.description: Display name.

owner.description:
Owner of this resource.

Account statuses are system-owned platform defaults shared across all accounts.

AccountUser.description:
A user's membership in an account, carrying the account-specific status, role, and department.

Profile fields (name, email, username, image URL) live on the expandable `user` sub-resource, which is shared across every account the user belongs to.

status.description:
Account user status.

- `active`: the user can access the account.
- `disabled`: the user is locked out of the account.
- `removed`: the user has been removed (soft-deleted) from the account.

last_used_at.description: When the user last accessed this account.

created_at.description: When the account user was created.

updated_at.description: When the account user was last updated.

Actor.description: Reference to an actor (user, API key, or agent).

type.description:
Actor type.

- `user`: a human user account.
- `api_key`: a programmatic caller authenticating with an API key.
- `agent`: an automated agent acting on the account's behalf.

name.description: The actor's display name.

handle.description:
Human-readable handle identifying the actor.

- For `user` actors: the user's email address.
- For `api_key` actors: the redacted key value.

Agent actors carry no handle.

Address.description: A saved address that can be used for billing and shipping on sales orders, invoices, and shipments.

name.description: Display name of the address.

phone.description: Phone number associated with the address.

email.description: Email address associated with the address.

type.description:
Address type.

- `standard`: a normal shipping or billing address.
- `drop_ship`: an address an order is shipped to directly, typically a third party or end customer rather than the account itself.

address_line_1.description: First line of the street address.

address_line_2.description: Second line of the street address.

AddressInput.description: Address details used to create an address, either directly or inline on another resource.

name.description: Display name of the address.

phone.description: Phone number associated with the address.

email.description: Email address associated with the address.

type.description:
Address type.

- `standard`: a normal shipping or billing address.
- `drop_ship`: an address an order is shipped to directly, typically a third party or end customer rather than the account itself.

street_line_1.description: First line of the street address.

street_line_2.description: Second line of the street address.

AdjustmentType.description:
A category of financial adjustment, such as a discount, fee, or write-off.

Adjustment types classify adjustment transactions recorded against customer invoices.

name.description: Human-readable name of the adjustment type (e.g. "Discount").

code.description:
Machine-readable code identifying what kind of adjustment this is.

- `discount`: a price reduction.
- `shipping_discrepancy`: corrects a difference between quoted and actual freight.
- `short_payment`: reconciles an invoice paid for less than the amount due.
- `write_off`: cancels an uncollectible balance.
- `fee`: an additional charge.
- `refund`: returns money to the customer.

owner.description:
Provenance of this adjustment type.

System-owned types are platform-provided defaults shared across all accounts; account-owned types are custom to one account.

Attribute.description:
A selectable value within a property, such as `Red` for a `Color` property.

Attributes are assigned to items to classify them.

value.description: The selectable value this attribute represents, such as `Red` for a `Color` property or `Large` for a `Size` property.

color.description:
Swatch color used to display this attribute in the UI.

The named colors are arbitrary display choices; `default` is a neutral fallback used when no specific swatch applies.

sort_order.description:
Position of this attribute relative to its siblings within the property, starting at `1`.

Positions are kept contiguous: creating, reordering, or deleting an attribute automatically shifts its siblings.

property.description:
The property this attribute belongs to.

Populated only when the attribute is returned under an item's `attributes` list.

AuditEvent.description:
Immutable audit event record.

Captures the actor, changed resource, and timestamp.

action.description:
Mutation type.

- `create`: the resource was created.
- `update`: one or more fields were changed.
- `delete`: the resource was deleted.
- `restore`: a previously deleted resource was restored.
- `archive`: the resource was archived.

resource_type.description: Resource type of the audited entity.

account.description:
Account the audited mutation was performed against.

For a mutation on one of your own resources this is your account; when you act on a customer's or supplier's account, it is that account.

changes.description: Field-level changes recorded for this event.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata for the mutation (e.g. reason, source, tags). Encoded as a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null), not a JSON-encoded string.

request.description:
Log of the API request that caused the mutation.

`null` when the change did not originate from an API request.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key of the originating request.

created_at.description: When the audit event record was created.

AuditFieldChange.description: Field-level before/after transition recorded during a mutation.

old_value.description:
Previous value as a JSON fragment.

`null` for creation events. Encoded as a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null), not a JSON-encoded string.

new_value.description:
New value as a JSON fragment.

`null` for deletion events. Encoded as a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null), not a JSON-encoded string.

Carrier.description:
A shipping carrier configured for fulfilling orders.

Carriers with a Shippo-supported `code` (`fedex`, `ups`, `usps`) are connected through Shippo for live rating and label purchase; other carriers represent self-managed shipping methods such as will call or local delivery.

name.description: Human-readable name for the carrier, unique among your account's carriers.

code.description:
Well-known carrier identifier, set only for recognized carriers and absent for custom ones.

- `fedex`, `ups`, `usps`: integrated carriers managed through Shippo (live rating and labels).
- `will_call`: customer picks the order up; no carrier shipment.
- `delivery`: delivered by your own vehicles/drivers.
- `ltl`, `ltl1`: less-than-truckload freight carriers.
- `freight_collect`: freight billed to and arranged by the receiver.

account_number.description: Your account number with this carrier, used to connect UPS and USPS accounts.

customer_portal_visibility.description: Whether customers can see and select this carrier at checkout in the customer portal.

owner.description:
Provenance of this carrier.

System-owned carriers are platform-provided defaults shared across all accounts and cannot be deleted; account-owned carriers are custom to your account.

service_levels.description: Shipping service levels offered by this carrier (e.g. ground, overnight).

Consumption.description:
Material consumed by a production step.

Each consumption records one input item and how much of it the step uses. Consumptions also determine the production flow: when another step produces the consumed item, the two steps are linked upstream/downstream automatically.

quantity.description: Quantity of the material consumed by the production step.

waste_quantity.description: Quantity of the material accounted for as waste, separate from the consumed quantity.

consumed_item.description: The item consumed by the production step.

instructions.description: Instructions for how this material is consumed.

CreateAPIKeyRequest.description: Request to create an API key.

role_id.description:
ID of the role to assign to the API key.

The role determines the permissions of requests authenticated with the key.

name.description: Human-readable name for the API key.

expires_at.description:
When the key expires and stops authenticating requests.

If omitted, the key never expires.

CreateAccountGroupRequest.description: Request to create an account group.

name.description:
Display name of the account group.

Must be unique within your account; maximum 255 characters.

type.description:
How this account group will be used.

- `pricing_group`: used for pricing rules, such as a "Preferred" group that receives a special discount.
- `type_group`: used to categorize accounts, such as "Consumers" or "Distributors".

The type cannot be changed after creation.

commission_policy.description:
How sales commission applies to accounts in this group.

- `commission_applied`: sales commission is calculated on orders from accounts in this group.
- `commission_exempt`: orders from accounts in this group are exempt from commission.

freight_policy.description:
How freight charges apply to orders from accounts in this group.

- `free_freight`: customers within this group will not have to pay for freight.
- `billed_freight`: freight will be applied to any order within this account group, unless overridden elsewhere.

description.description: Free-form description of the account group.

CreateAccountUserRequest.description: Request to create an account user.

name.description: User display name.

email.description:
User email address.

Either `email` or `username` must be provided. If a user with this email already exists, that user is added to the account instead of a new user being created.

username.description:
Unique username.

3–255 characters; letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens. Either `email` or `username` must be provided. Providing a username without an email creates a scanning station user.

password.description:
Password for scanning station users.

Required when creating a scanning station user (username without email) and rejected for all other users, who instead receive a generated password in their welcome email. Must be 8–72 characters and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a special character.

role_id.description:
ID of the role to assign to the user.

Ignored for scanning station users, which are always assigned the scanner role.

department_id.description: ID of the department to assign to the user.

preferences.description:
Notification preference toggles for the new user.

Only applies when creating a user in another account you manage (cross-account); ignored when creating a user in your own account.

value.description:
The selectable value this attribute represents, such as `Red`.

Must be unique across all attributes in the account, not just within the property. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.

color.description:
Swatch color used to display this attribute in the UI.

When omitted, one of the nine named colors (everything except `default`) is assigned at random.

sort_order.description:
Position of the new attribute relative to its siblings within the property, starting at `1`.

Must be at most the property's current attribute count plus one; siblings at or after this position are shifted one position later. Defaults to the last position if not provided.

name.description:
Human-readable name for the carrier.

Must be unique among your account's carriers.

code.description:
Well-known carrier code.

Omit for a custom carrier. Providing a Shippo-supported code (`fedex`, `ups`, `usps`) connects the carrier through Shippo and auto-syncs its service levels.

account_number.description:
Your account number with this carrier.

Required when `code` is `ups` or `usps`, which connect to Shippo using this number; FedEx connects via OAuth instead.

customer_portal_visibility.description:
Carrier visibility in the customer portal.

A `visible` carrier can be selected by your customers at checkout; a `hidden` carrier is not offered there. New carriers are visible unless set to `hidden`.

name.description: The customer's business name, as shown throughout the app and on documents.

number.description:
Human-readable customer number used to identify the account, distinct from the `id`.

Must be unique within your account. If omitted, the next sequential number is assigned automatically.

status.description:
Account status code, controlling whether the customer can transact.

- `normal`: standard active account with no restrictions.
- `preferred`: active account flagged as preferred.
- `hold_shipment`: orders can be placed, but shipments are held.
- `hold_all`: all activity is on hold.

edi_status.description: Whether EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) is enabled for exchanging orders and documents with this customer.

commission_policy.description:
How sales commission applies to this customer's orders.

- `commission_exempt`: this customer's orders are exempt from sales commission.
- `commission_applied`: sales commission is calculated on this customer's orders.

freight_policy.description:
Whether this customer is billed for freight on their orders.

- `free_freight`: the customer is not billed for freight.
- `billed_freight`: freight is billed to the customer, unless overridden on the order.

default_carrier_id.description: ID of the default carrier for this customer's shipments.

default_service_level_id.description: ID of the default carrier service level.

default_priority.description: Priority applied to new orders for this customer.

default_sales_rep_id.description: The ID of the account user to assign as the default sales rep.

customer_price_group_ids.description: IDs of the account groups of type `pricing_group` to assign to this customer, used to apply pricing rules.

customer_type_group_id.description: ID of the account group of type `type_group` that categorizes this customer (for example "Distributors").

carrier_billing_type.description:
Who pays the carrier for shipments.

- `sender`: the shipper (you) pays the carrier.
- `third_party`: a third party is billed, using `carrier_billing_account`.

carrier_billing_account.description: Carrier billing account number charged when `carrier_billing_type` is `third_party`.

credit_limit.description: Maximum credit extended to this customer.

bill_to_address.description: Default billing address, created along with the customer.

ship_to_address.description:
Default shipping address, created along with the customer.

If identical to `bill_to_address`, a single shared address record is created.

CreateItemCategoryRequest.description: Request to create an item category.

name.description: Display name of the item category.

type.description:
What kind of items this category groups.

- `material_category`: groups raw materials and components (items of type `material`).
- `product_category`: groups finished products and parts (items of type `product` or `part`).

unit_group_id.description:
ID of the unit group that determines the units of measure available to items in this category.

After creation, the unit group can only be replaced by another unit group of the same unit type via the Change Item Category Unit Group endpoint.

name.description:
Display name of the location.

Maximum 255 characters.

type.description:
Location type code, identifying this location's level in the storage hierarchy.

- `building`: a building-level location.
- `section`: a section within a building.
- `aisle`: an aisle within a section.
- `rack`: a rack within an aisle.
- `shelf`: a shelf within a rack.
- `bin`: a bin within a shelf.

parent_id.description:
ID of the parent location.

Omit for top-level locations.

child_ids.description:
IDs of existing locations to attach as children of the new location.

Listed locations are moved from their current parent, if any.

sku.description:
Stock keeping unit code for the material.

Must be unique within the account; creating a material with a SKU already used by another item fails with a conflict error.

category_id.description:
ID of the item category to place the material in.

The category's unit group determines the base unit used for the material's rates (`unit_value`, `unit_cost`, `burn_rate`).

order_point.description:
Reorder threshold: when on-hand stock falls to this quantity, the material should be reordered.

When omitted, the order point is initialized to a zero quantity in the category's base unit.

lead_time.description:
Expected time between placing an order for this material and receiving it, expressed as a quantity in a time unit (e.g. days).

When omitted, the lead time is initialized to a zero quantity in the category's base unit.

unit_price.description:
Initial selling price per unit.

`numerator_unit_id` must reference a currency unit and `denominator_unit_id` must reference a non-currency unit (e.g. `$5` per `ea`). When omitted, the price is initialized to a zero rate in the category's base unit.

unit_cost.description:
Initial cost per unit.

Follows the same unit rule as `unit_price`: currency numerator, non-currency denominator. When omitted, the cost is initialized to a zero rate in the category's base unit.

attribute_ids.description: IDs of existing attributes to link to the material at creation time.

sku.description:
Stock keeping unit code for the part.

Must be unique within the account; creating a part with a SKU already used by another item fails with a conflict error.

category_id.description:
ID of the item category to place the part in.

The category's unit group determines the base unit used for the part's rates (`unit_value`, `unit_cost`, `burn_rate`).

unit_price.description:
Initial selling price per unit.

`numerator_unit_id` must reference a currency unit and `denominator_unit_id` must reference a non-currency unit (e.g. `$5` per `ea`). When omitted, the price is initialized to a zero rate in the category's base unit.

unit_cost.description:
Initial cost per unit.

Follows the same unit rule as `unit_price`: currency numerator, non-currency denominator. When omitted, the cost is initialized to a zero rate in the category's base unit.

attribute_ids.description: IDs of existing attributes to link to the part at creation time.

CreatePaymentTermRequest.description: Request to create a payment term.

name.description:
Display name (e.g. `Net 30`).

Must be unique among the payment terms visible to your account, including system defaults.

CreateProductLineRequest.description: Request to create a product line.

name.description:
Display name.

Must be unique among the account's product lines; a duplicate name returns a conflict error.

unit_group_id.description:
ID of the unit group to associate with this product line.

The unit group determines the set of units available to products in this product line.

commission_policy.description:
Default commission policy for products in this product line.

- `commission_exempt`: no commission applies to these products.
- `commission_applied`: commission applies to these products, unless overridden elsewhere.

freight_policy.description:
Default freight policy for products in this product line.

- `free_freight`: these products do not incur a freight charge.
- `billed_freight`: freight is billed for these products, unless overridden elsewhere.

CreateProductRequest.description: CreateProductRequest is the request to create a product.

sku.description:
Stock keeping unit code for the product's item.

Must be unique within the account; creation fails with a conflict error if another item already uses it.

type.description:
Product type code, which determines how the product behaves on orders and invoices.

- `sale`: a standard sellable product.
- `service`: a non-physical service line, such as labor or installation.
- `shipping`: a shipping charge applied to an order.
- `credit`: a credit applied against an order or invoice.
- `return`: a returned product (RMA).
- `tax`: a tax line.

product_line_id.description: ID of the product line to assign the product to.

category_id.description:
ID of the item category for the product's item.

The category's unit group determines the default units used for the product's pricing rates and inventory tracking.

portal_visibility.description:
Whether the product is shown to buyers in the customer portal.

- `visible`: buyers can see and order the product in the portal.
- `hidden`: the product is concealed from the portal but remains usable internally.

When omitted, the product is created hidden, so it must be set to `visible` before buyers can see it.

unit_price.description:
Initial selling price per unit.

When set, the numerator unit must be a currency unit and the denominator unit must not be. When omitted, the price is initialized to a zero rate in the category's base unit.

unit_cost.description:
Initial cost per unit.

The same unit rule as `unit_price` applies: the numerator unit must be a currency unit and the denominator unit must not be. When omitted, the cost is initialized to a zero rate in the category's base unit.

attribute_ids.description: Attribute IDs to connect to the product at creation time.

name.description: Display name of the property, such as `Color` or `Size`.

CreateRoleRequest.description: CreateRoleRequest is a request to create a role.

name.description: Display name for the role, unique within the account.

permissions.description:
Permissions to grant, in `{domain}:{action}` format, such as `customers:read`.

The action must be one of `create`, `read`, `update`, or `delete`. Omit to create a role with no permissions.

name.description: Display name.

mode.description:
Controls how the sandbox is initialized.

- `blank`: starts empty, with no pre-populated data.
- `seeded`: starts with sample data, populated asynchronously after the sandbox is created.

CreateScanningStationRequest.description: Request to create a scanning station.

name.description:
Display name of the scanning station.

Must be unique within your account; maximum 255 characters.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the scanning station.

type.description:
Scanning station type, determining which batch operation the station performs.

- `init_batch`: initializes a new batch.
- `merge_batch`: merges multiple batches into one.
- `move_batch`: moves a batch to another location or step.
- `split_batch`: splits a batch into multiple batches.

The type cannot be changed after creation.

operator_requirement.description:
Whether operators must perform a material check at this station.

- `none`: no additional operator check is required.
- `material_check`: a material check is expected before the operation.

department_id.description: ID of the department this station belongs to.

label_size.description: Size of the labels printed at this station, given as width-by-height (for example, `1x1`).

label_type.description:
Type of label printed at this station.

- `tag`: a label attached to the physical product.
- `traveler`: a routing sheet that accompanies the batch through every production step.

CreateServiceLevelRequest.description: Request to create a service level.

name.description: Human-readable name for the service level, shown to customers at checkout when the service level is visible.

code.description:
Carrier-specific code identifying this service level (e.g. `fedex_ground`).

Must be unique among the carrier's service levels.

customer_portal_visibility.description:
Service level visibility in the customer portal.

A `visible` service level can be selected by your customers at checkout; a `hidden` one is not offered there. New service levels are visible unless set to `hidden`.

is_default.description:
Whether this becomes the carrier's default service level, pre-selected when the carrier is chosen.

Each carrier has at most one default; setting this to `true` clears the carrier's existing default.

CreateShippingTermRequest.description: Request to create a shipping term.

name.description: Human-readable name for the shipping term, used to identify it when assigning shipping terms to customers and orders.

type.description:
Freight pricing model applied by this shipping term.

- `free_freight`: no shipping cost to the buyer.
- `flat_rate_freight`: a fixed shipping cost regardless of order details (see `flat_rate`).
- `carrier_rate_freight`: shipping cost is determined by the carrier's quoted rate.

flat_rate.description:
Fixed shipping charge applied to orders.

Only applied when `type` is `flat_rate_freight`.

minimum_order_value.description: Order subtotal a buyer must reach for this term's free-shipping rules to apply.

free_shipping_service_level_ids.description: IDs of service levels that ship for free under this term (typically once `minimum_order_value` is met).

CreateUnitGroupRequest.description: Request to create a unit group.

name.description:
Display name of the unit group.

Must be unique within the account.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the unit group.

type.description:
Dimension shared by every unit in this group (e.g. `mass`, `volume`).

All associated units must be of this dimension.

base_unit_id.description: ID of the unit to designate as the group's reference unit.

associated_units.description: Associated units to create with the group.

CreateUnitGroupUnitParam.description: Parameters for associating a unit with a unit group.

unit_id.description:
ID of the unit to associate with the group.

The unit's dimension must match the group's `type`.

discount_percentage.description: Percentage discount applied to the unit's price when an order is placed in this unit (e.g. `10` is a 10% discount).

discount_fixed.description: Flat amount subtracted from the unit's price when an order is placed in this unit.

customer_portal_visibility.description: Whether the unit is shown to customers in the customer portal.

CreateUnitGroupUnitRequest.description: Request to add a unit to a unit group.

unit_id.description:
ID of the unit to associate with the group.

The unit's dimension must match the group's `type`.

discount_percentage.description: Percentage discount applied to the unit's price when an order is placed in this unit (e.g. `10` is a 10% discount).

discount_fixed.description: Flat amount subtracted from the unit's price when an order is placed in this unit.

customer_portal_visibility.description: Whether the unit is shown to customers in the customer portal.

name.description:
Display name of the unit (e.g. "Gram").

Must be unique within the account.

abbreviation.description:
Short abbreviation for the unit (e.g. "g").

Must be unique within the account.

type.description:
Unit dimension (e.g. `mass`, `volume`, `currency`).

Units can only be converted to other units of the same dimension.

ratio_numerator.description: Conversion ratio numerator relative to the base unit, as a decimal string.

ratio_denominator.description: Conversion ratio denominator relative to the base unit, as a decimal string. Must not be zero.

offset_numerator.description: Conversion offset numerator, as a decimal string.

offset_denominator.description: Conversion offset denominator, as a decimal string. Must not be zero.

CreatedAPIKey.description: Result of creating an API key, with the full secret value.

api_key_secret.description:
Full secret value.

Returned once and cannot be retrieved later. Learn more about [managing your API keys](https://docs.augno.com/api/managing-api-keys).

Customer.description: A business you sell to, with its contact details, default fulfillment settings, and order policies.

name.description: The customer's business name, as shown throughout the app and on documents.

number.description: Human-readable customer number used to identify the account, distinct from the `id`.

status.description:
Account status code, controlling whether the customer can transact.

- `normal`: standard active account with no restrictions.
- `preferred`: active account flagged as preferred.
- `hold_shipment`: orders can be placed, but shipments are held.
- `hold_all`: all activity is on hold.

edi_status.description: Whether EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) is enabled for exchanging orders and documents with this customer.

relationship_type.description:
The customer's position in the account hierarchy.

- `standalone`: no parent or child accounts.
- `parent`: has one or more child accounts (see `child_accounts`).
- `child`: belongs to a parent account (see `parent_account`).

commission_policy.description:
How sales commission applies to this customer's orders.

- `commission_exempt`: this customer's orders are exempt from sales commission.
- `commission_applied`: sales commission is calculated on this customer's orders.

credit_limit.description: Maximum credit extended to this customer.

freight_preferences.description: Freight and carrier preferences applied to this customer's shipments.

defaults.description: Default settings applied to new orders for this customer.

type.description: The account group of type `type_group` that categorizes this customer (for example "Distributors").

price_groups.description: Account groups of type `pricing_group` that this customer belongs to, used to apply pricing rules.

parent_account.description:
Parent account.

Present if this is a child account.

child_accounts.description:
Child accounts.

Present if this is a parent account.

status.description:
Freight policy applied to this customer's orders.

- `free_freight`: the customer is not billed for freight.
- `billed_freight`: freight is billed to the customer, unless overridden elsewhere.

billing_type.description:
Who pays the carrier for shipments.

- `sender`: the shipper (you) pays the carrier.
- `third_party`: a third party is billed, using `billing_account`.

billing_account.description: Carrier billing account number charged when `billing_type` is `third_party`.

Department.description: A functional area of a production operation, such as fabrication or packaging, that groups scanning stations and machines.

name.description:
Display name of the department.

Unique within the account.

location.description: The storage location where this department operates.

EmailLog.description: A record of an email sent on the account's behalf, such as an invoice or a user invitation.

send_status.description:
Email send status.

- `pending`: the email is queued and has not been sent yet.
- `sent`: the email has been handed off for delivery.

sent_by.description:
The user who sent the email.

Absent for emails the platform sends automatically (for example system notifications), which are not attributed to a user.

Geolocation.description: The street-level location details of an address.

street_line_1.description: First line of the street address.

street_line_2.description: Second line of the street address.

Item.description: Item is an inventory item (product, material, or part).

sku.description: Stock keeping unit code, unique within the account.

type.description:
What kind of item this is.

- `product`: a finished product.
- `material`: a raw material or component consumed in production.
- `part`: a part used in production.

category.description:
The category this item belongs to.

The category's unit group determines the base unit the item's rates (`unit_value`, `unit_cost`, `burn_rate`) are expressed in.

unit_value.description: Selling value per unit, expressed as a rate (e.g. `$25.50 / kg`).

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit, expressed as a rate (e.g. `$10.00 / kg`).

burn_rate.description: Rate at which this item is consumed in production, expressed as a quantity over time (e.g. `100 kg / hr`).

ItemCategory.description: A grouping of related catalog items that defines the unit group and properties available to the items within it.

name.description: Display name of the item category.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the item category.

type.description:
What kind of items this category groups.

An item can only be assigned to a category whose type matches the item's `type`.

- `material_category`: groups raw materials and components (items of type `material`).
- `product_category`: groups finished products and parts (items of type `product` or `part`).

owner.description:
Owner of the item category.

System-owned categories are platform defaults (the `owner.type` is `system` and `owner.account` is `null`); account-owned categories were created by your organization.

properties.description: Properties associated with this item category.

unit_group.description:
Unit group associated with this item category.

This unit group determines the units of measure available to items in this category throughout your production process.

ItemInventory.description: ItemInventory contains inventory quantities for an item.

reserved.description: Quantity committed to existing orders and therefore not free to allocate.

available_to_promise.description: Quantity free to commit to new orders, i.e. on-hand minus reserved minus short.

short.description: Quantity by which demand exceeds available supply (the unfulfillable shortfall).

Location.description: A physical storage location, such as a warehouse, aisle, or bin, arranged in a parent-child hierarchy.

name.description: Display name of the location.

type.description:
Location type code, identifying this location's level in the storage hierarchy.

- `building`: a building-level location.
- `section`: a section within a building.
- `aisle`: an aisle within a section.
- `rack`: a rack within an aisle.
- `shelf`: a shelf within a rack.
- `bin`: a bin within a shelf.

parent.description:
The location directly above this one in the storage hierarchy.

Absent for top-level locations.

children.description: The locations directly below this one in the storage hierarchy.

LocationType.description: A level in the storage location hierarchy, such as a building or a bin.

code.description:
Location type code, identifying the level of the storage hierarchy this type represents.

- `building`: a building-level location.
- `section`: a section within a building.
- `aisle`: an aisle within a section.
- `rack`: a rack within an aisle.
- `shelf`: a shelf within a rack.
- `bin`: a bin within a shelf.

name.description: Display name of the location type.

Machine.description: A piece of production equipment, such as a CNC router or press, assigned to a department.

name.description:
Display name of the machine.

Unique within the account.

department.description: The department this machine belongs to.

Material.description:
A material in the account's catalog: a raw material or component consumed in production.

Material-level data such as the SKU, description, category, pricing, and attributes lives on the underlying `item`; the material record adds the reordering fields `order_point` and `lead_time`.

item.description: The underlying inventory item this material record extends with material-specific fields such as order point and lead time.

order_point.description:
Reorder threshold: when on-hand stock falls to this quantity, the material should be reordered.

Initialized to a zero quantity in the category's base unit when not provided at creation.

lead_time.description:
Expected time between placing an order for this material and receiving it, expressed as a quantity in a time unit (e.g. days).

Initialized to a zero quantity in the category's base unit when not provided at creation.

MergeCustomersRequest.description: Request to merge source customers into a target customer.

source_customer_ids.description:
IDs of the source customers to merge into the target.

Sources are deleted after the merge. The list must not contain duplicates or the target customer's ID.

NotificationPreferenceItem.description: NotificationPreferenceItem toggles a single account-relation notification type.

enabled.description: Whether this notification type is enabled for the account user.

Owner.description: Owner describes the provenance of a resource.

type.description:
Owner type, identifying where the resource came from.

- `system`: a platform-provided default shared across all accounts; not editable.
- `account`: created and owned by a specific account; the `account` field identifies which.

account.description:
The account that owns this resource.

Present only when `type` is `account`; system-owned resources have no owning account.

next_page_url.description:
Relative URL that fetches the next page of results.

`null` when the last page has been reached.

previous_page_url.description:
Relative URL that fetches the previous page of results.

`null` while on the first page.

has_next_page.description: Whether more results exist after this page.

has_prev_page.description: Whether results exist before this page.

Part.description:
A part in the account's catalog: a component used in production.

Part-level data such as the SKU, description, category, pricing, and attributes lives on the underlying `item`.

item.description: The underlying inventory item this part record represents.

PaymentTerm.description: A payment term describing when payment is due (e.g. `Net 30`), assignable to customers, sales orders, purchase orders, and invoices.

name.description: Display name (e.g. `Net 30`).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the payment term.

owner.description: Owner of this resource, indicating whether it is an Augno-provided system default or was created by your account.

Priority.description: Priority level used to order work on sales orders, purchase orders, and picks.

code.description:
Machine-readable code identifying the priority level.

- `low`: lowest urgency; worked after normal and high.
- `normal`: default urgency for most orders and picks.
- `high`: highest urgency; worked ahead of normal and low.

name.description: Display name.

owner.description:
Owner of this resource.

Priorities are platform-provided and shared across all accounts, so the owner is always the Augno system owner.

Product.description: Product pairs an inventory item with how it is sold: its product type, optional product line, and customer portal visibility.

type.description:
Product type code, which determines how the product behaves on orders and invoices.

- `sale`: a standard sellable product.
- `service`: a non-physical service line, such as labor or installation.
- `shipping`: a shipping charge applied to an order.
- `credit`: a credit applied against an order or invoice.
- `return`: a returned product (RMA).
- `tax`: a tax line.

portal_visibility.description:
Whether the product is shown to buyers in the customer portal.

- `visible`: buyers can see and order the product in the portal.
- `hidden`: the product is concealed from the portal but remains usable internally.

product_line.description: The product line this product is assigned to, if any.

item.description: The inventory item backing this product, which holds its SKU, description, pricing, and attributes.

ProductLine.description:
Product line resource.

A product line groups related products in your catalog and carries the default commission policy, freight policy, and unit group for those products.

name.description: Display name of the product line.

description.description: Free-form description of the product line.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the product line.

commission_policy.description:
Default commission policy for products in this product line.

- `commission_exempt`: no commission applies to these products.
- `commission_applied`: commission applies to these products, unless overridden elsewhere.

freight_policy.description:
Default freight policy for products in this product line.

- `free_freight`: these products do not incur a freight charge.
- `billed_freight`: freight is billed for these products, unless overridden elsewhere.

owner.description:
Owner of the product line.

System-owned product lines are platform-provided and shared across all accounts; account-owned product lines are custom to your account.

unit_group.description:
Unit group associated with this product line.

The unit group determines the set of units available to products in this product line.

ProductionOutput.description: The output of a production step: the item it produces and the quantity produced.

ProductionStep.description: A single stage of work in an item's production flow, with its output, material inputs, cost rates, and graph connections.

name.description: Display name of the step.

leveling_factor.description:
Leveling correction factor applied to labor time in cost calculations, as a decimal string.

Effective labor time per unit is `labor_time × (1 + leveling_factor) × (1 + allowances)`.

allowances.description:
Allowance correction factor applied to labor time in cost calculations, as a decimal string.

Effective labor time per unit is `labor_time × (1 + leveling_factor) × (1 + allowances)`.

labor_rate.description: Cost of labor for this step, expressed as a rate of currency per unit of time (e.g. `$` per `hr`).

labor_time.description: Labor duration for this step, expressed as a rate (e.g. time per unit of output).

overhead_rate.description: Overhead cost for this step, expressed as a rate of currency per unit of time (e.g. `$` per `hr`).

production.description: The item and quantity this step produces.

consumptions.description: Materials this step consumes as inputs, with their quantities and expected waste.

scanning_station.description: Scanning station where this step's batches are scanned.

in_steps.description: Steps that feed into this step.

out_steps.description: Steps that this step feeds into.

Property.description:
A named characteristic used to classify items, such as `Color` or `Size`.

Each property defines a set of attributes — the selectable values (e.g. `Red`, `Blue`) that can be assigned to items.

name.description: Display name of the property, such as `Color` or `Size`.

value.description:
Raw decimal value of the quantity, as a string to preserve precision.

This is the unformatted machine value; see `display_value` for the human-readable rendering with unit and thousands separators.

display_value.description: Formatted value with unit abbreviation (e.g. "$1,234.56" or "100 kg").

unit.description: Unit of measure for this value (e.g. a currency, mass, or count unit).

QuantityInput.description: A value with an associated unit, used in create and update requests.

value.description: Decimal value, as a string to preserve precision.

unit_id.description: ID of the unit of measure for the value.

QuantityInputRequest.description: QuantityInputRequest is a quantity value and unit.

unit_id.description: ID of the unit the value is expressed in.

QuotaInfo.description:
QuotaInfo provides machine-readable details about a plan-imposed resource limit.
Included in limit_exceeded errors so clients can display upgrade prompts, usage bars,
or implement programmatic retry/backoff logic.

limit.description: Limit is the maximum number of resources allowed by the current plan.

used.description: Used is the number of resources currently consumed.

reset_at.description: ResetAt is the time when the quota resets, if applicable. Nil for static (non-metered) limits.

Rate.description: Value expressed as a ratio of two units, such as a price per kilogram or a throughput per hour.

value.description:
Decimal value of the rate, as a string to preserve precision.

Expressed as the amount of the numerator unit per one denominator unit.

numerator_unit.description: Unit of the rate's numerator (e.g. the currency of a price).

denominator_unit.description: Unit of the rate's denominator (the per-unit basis, e.g. kilograms for a price per kilogram).

display_value.description: Human-readable formatted value (e.g. "$25.50 / kg" or "100 kg / hr").

RateInput.description: A rate value with its numerator and denominator units, used in create and update requests.

value.description: Decimal value of the rate, expressed as the amount of the numerator unit per one denominator unit.

numerator_unit_id.description: ID of the unit for the rate's numerator (e.g. the currency of a price).

denominator_unit_id.description: ID of the unit for the rate's denominator (the per-unit basis).

RequestLog.description: A log of a single API request, capturing its route, outcome, latency, and actor.

normalized_route.description:
The route template the request matched, with path parameters left as placeholders.

For example `/v1/sales/customers/{id}` is the normalized route for the request path `/v1/sales/customers/ac_...`. Falls back to the raw path when the request did not match a registered route.

query_params.description: Query parameters. Encoded as a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null), not a JSON-encoded string.

error_code.description:
Machine-readable API error code.

Populated only for failed requests.

error_message.description:
Human-readable error message.

Populated only for failed requests.

created_at.description: When the log entry was created.

account.description:
Account _targeted_ by the request: the account the request acted upon.

Results are scoped to logs where your account is either the acting account or the target account. Use the `target_account_ids` query parameter to filter by which account was acted upon, and `actor_account_ids` to filter by who acted.

request_body.description: Request body. Encoded as a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null), not a JSON-encoded string.

response_body.description: Response body. Encoded as a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null), not a JSON-encoded string.

ResponseError.description:
ResponseError is the JSON-serializable error body returned to API clients. It contains
only public information. This struct is used by the OpenAPI schema generator to produce
documentation.

code.description: A machine-readable code for the error.

type.description: The type of error.

message.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error.

param.description: The parameter that caused the error, if applicable.

doc_url.description: A URL to documentation about the error.

is_transient.description: Whether this error is transient and the request can be retried.

quota.description: Quota provides plan limit details when the error is limit_exceeded. Nil otherwise.

request_log_url.description:
RequestLogURL is a link to the dashboard page for this request's log entry.
Nil when no request log is available.

Role.description: A named set of permissions that can be assigned to users to control what they can access.

name.description: Display name, unique within the account.

type.description:
The kind of role.

The role's type is sometimes used to gate special behaviors and to restrict some actions to only certain types of roles. For example, only roles with the type `admin` can create and manage API keys.

- `admin`: full administrative access, including managing API keys.
- `user`: a custom role tailored to a specific need (its permissions are defined explicitly). Roles created through the API always have this type.
- `scanner`: a role for scanning-station operators.
- `sales_rep`: a role for sales representatives.
- `agent`: a role assigned to an automated agent rather than a person.

owner.description:
Provenance of this role.

System-owned roles are global defaults shared across all accounts and cannot be modified or deleted; account-owned roles are custom roles created by that account.

permissions.description: Permissions granted by this role, in `{domain}:{action}` format, such as `customers:read`.

RotateAPIKeyRequest.description: Request to rotate an API key.

expires_at.description:
Expiration timestamp override for the new key.

If omitted, the previous key's expiration is used.

revoke_at.description:
When to revoke the old key.

If omitted, the old key is revoked immediately. A future timestamp schedules revocation (keeping the old key valid until then) up to a maximum of 30 days out.

code.description:
Machine-readable status code.

- `estimate`: a draft quote that has not yet been committed.
- `issued`: the order has been issued and is being fulfilled.
- `fulfilled`: the order has been completed and closed.

name.description: Display name.

owner.description: The owner of this status value; sales order statuses are platform-defined.

name.description: Display name.

owner_account.description: The production account that owns this sandbox.

updated_at.description: When this sandbox was last updated.

ScanningStation.description: A station on the production floor where operators scan batches to perform a batch operation, such as initializing or moving a batch.

name.description:
Display name of the scanning station.

Unique within the account.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the scanning station.

type.description:
Scanning station type, determining which batch operation the station performs.

- `init_batch`: initializes a new batch.
- `merge_batch`: merges multiple batches into one.
- `move_batch`: moves a batch to another location or step.
- `split_batch`: splits a batch into multiple batches.

label_size.description: Size of the labels printed at this station, given as width-by-height (for example, `1x1`).

label_type.description:
Type of label printed at this station.

- `tag`: a label attached to the physical product.
- `traveler`: a routing sheet that accompanies the batch through every production step.

operator_requirement.description:
Whether operators must perform a material check at this station.

- `none`: no additional operator check is required.
- `material_check`: a material check is expected before the operation.

department.description: The department this scanning station belongs to.

production_steps.description:
Production steps connected to this station.

A production step can be connected to at most one scanning station.

ServiceLevel.description: Shipping service level for a carrier.

name.description: Human-readable name for the service level, shown to customers at checkout when the service level is visible.

service_level_token.description:
Carrier-specific code identifying this service level (e.g. `fedex_ground`, `ups_next_day_air`).

Values are carrier-defined, so any non-empty string is accepted.

customer_portal_visibility.description: Whether customers can see and select this service level at checkout in the customer portal.

is_default.description:
Whether this is the carrier's default service level, pre-selected when the carrier is chosen.

Each carrier has at most one default; setting a new default clears the previous one.

owner.description:
Provenance of this service level.

System-owned service levels are platform-provided defaults that cannot be updated or deleted; account-owned service levels are custom to your account.

ShippingTerm.description: A shipping term defining how freight charges are calculated for an order.

name.description: Human-readable name for the shipping term, used to identify it when assigning shipping terms to customers and orders.

type.description:
Freight pricing model applied by this shipping term.

- `free_freight`: no shipping cost to the buyer.
- `flat_rate_freight`: a fixed shipping cost regardless of order details (see `flat_rate`).
- `carrier_rate_freight`: shipping cost is determined by the carrier's quoted rate.

owner.description:
Provenance of this shipping term.

System-owned shipping terms are platform-provided defaults shared across all accounts and cannot be updated or deleted; account-owned shipping terms are custom to your account.

flat_rate.description:
Fixed shipping charge applied to the order.

Applied only when `type` is `flat_rate_freight`; ignored for other freight pricing models.

minimum_order_value.description: Order subtotal a buyer must reach before this term's free-shipping rules apply.

free_shipping_service_levels.description: Service levels that ship for free under this term (typically once `minimum_order_value` is met).

created_at.description: When this shipping term was created.

updated_at.description: When this shipping term was last updated.

TransactionMethod.description: The payment method used to make a transaction, such as cash or check.

name.description: Display name.

code.description: Machine-readable code identifying how the transaction was made.

TransactionType.description: The category of a financial transaction, such as a payment or credit memo.

name.description: Display name.

code.description:
Machine-readable code identifying the kind of transaction.

- `payment`: money received from the customer.
- `credit_memo`: a credit issued to the customer.
- `adjustment`: a manual correction (see the transaction's `adjustment_type`).
- `rebate`: a rebate granted to the customer.

Unit.description: Unit of measurement used for conversions and product quantities.

name.description: Display name of the unit (e.g. "Gram", "Kilogram").

type.description:
Physical dimension the unit measures, such as mass, volume, or currency.

A unit can only be converted to another unit of the same dimension. The `quantity` dimension is for discrete countable items rather than a physical measure.

ratio_numerator.description: Conversion ratio numerator relative to the base unit in the same dimension.

ratio_denominator.description:
Conversion ratio denominator relative to the base unit in the same dimension.

Cannot be zero.

offset_numerator.description:
Conversion offset numerator, used for temperature-like conversions.

Zero for most unit types.

offset_denominator.description:
Conversion offset denominator.

Typically 1. Cannot be zero.

is_base_unit.description:
Whether this is the base unit for its dimension.

Conversion ratios are relative to this unit. Base units are platform-defined; account-created units always have this set to `false`.

updated_at.description: When this unit was last updated.

UnitGroup.description: Named collection of units sharing one dimension, defining which units products can be ordered in along with per-unit discounts and customer portal visibility.

name.description: Display name.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the unit group.

type.description:
Physical dimension shared by every unit in this group, such as mass, volume, or currency.

Only units of this dimension can belong to the group.

base_unit.description: The reference unit designated for this group.

associated_units.description: Units associated with this group, each with its own discount and customer portal visibility settings.

UnitGroupUnit.description: Membership of a unit in a unit group, carrying the discount and customer portal visibility settings applied when ordering in that unit.

unit.description: The unit this association refers to.

discount_percentage.description: Percentage discount applied to the unit's price when an order is placed in this unit (e.g. `10` is a 10% discount).

discount_fixed.description: Flat amount subtracted from the unit's price when an order is placed in this unit.

customer_portal_visibility.description: Whether this unit is shown to customers in the customer portal.

UpdateAccountGroupRequest.description: Request to partially update an account group.

name.description:
Display name of the account group.

Must be unique within your account; maximum 255 characters.

description.description: Free-form description of the account group.

commission_policy.description:
How sales commission applies to accounts in this group.

- `commission_applied`: sales commission is calculated on orders from accounts in this group.
- `commission_exempt`: orders from accounts in this group are exempt from commission.

freight_policy.description:
How freight charges apply to orders from accounts in this group.

- `free_freight`: customers within this group will not have to pay for freight.
- `billed_freight`: freight will be applied to any order within this account group, unless overridden elsewhere.

UpdateAccountUserRequest.description: Request to partially update an account user.

name.description: User display name.

email.description:
User email address.

Must not already be in use by another user.

username.description:
Unique username.

3–255 characters; letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens. Must not already be in use by another user.

role_id.description:
ID of the role to assign to the user.

Set to `null` to clear the role.

department_id.description:
ID of the department to assign to the user.

Set to `null` to clear the department.

preferences.description:
Notification preference toggles to apply.

Only allowed when updating a user in another account you manage (cross-account); rejected otherwise. Notification types omitted from the list are left unchanged.

UpdateAddressRequest.description:
Request to partially update an address.

Omitted fields are left unchanged.

name.description: Display name of the address.

phone.description:
Phone number associated with the address.

Send `null` to clear.

email.description:
Email address associated with the address.

Send `null` to clear.

type.description:
Address type.

- `standard`: a normal shipping or billing address.
- `drop_ship`: an address an order is shipped to directly, typically a third party or end customer rather than the account itself.

street_line_1.description: First line of the street address.

street_line_2.description:
Second line of the street address.

Send `null` to clear.

value.description:
The selectable value this attribute represents, such as `Red`.

Must be non-blank and unique across all attributes in the account, not just within the property.

color.description: Swatch color used to display this attribute in the UI.

sort_order.description:
New position of this attribute relative to its siblings within the property, starting at `1`.

Must be at most the property's current attribute count; the attributes between the old and new positions shift to make room.

name.description: Human-readable name for the carrier, unique among your account's carriers.

customer_portal_visibility.description:
Carrier visibility in the customer portal.

If `visible`, this carrier will be available for your customers to utilize when they go to checkout. If `hidden`, this carrier will not be an option on checkout.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Request to partially update a customer.

name.description: The customer's business name, as shown throughout the app and on documents.

number.description:
Human-readable customer number used to identify the account, distinct from the `id`.

Must be unique within your account.

status.description:
Account status code, controlling whether the customer can transact.

- `normal`: standard active account with no restrictions.
- `preferred`: active account flagged as preferred.
- `hold_shipment`: orders can be placed, but shipments are held.
- `hold_all`: all activity is on hold.

edi_status.description: Whether EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) is enabled for exchanging orders and documents with this customer.

commission_policy.description:
How sales commission applies to this customer's orders.

- `commission_exempt`: this customer's orders are exempt from sales commission.
- `commission_applied`: sales commission is calculated on this customer's orders.

freight_policy.description:
Whether this customer is billed for freight on their orders.

- `free_freight`: the customer is not billed for freight.
